note: What kaggle/colab_official_agent.ipynb runs, in order (028 AI9, #687): the two arms of the registered pair (specs/028-dataops-task-set/preregistration-colab-paired-run.md). A notebook that has made the runs it started with keeps reading this list. A run whose results are already on Kaggle is not made again, and one that stopped part way goes on from where it stopped. `-try2`: each arm stopped before its kernel started, on Kaggle's "not found" for the whole download of its bundle; listed again so a notebook that is still open makes it, with the bundle fetched file by file. `gpu`: two notebook sessions were open and both made the first arm, one on an A100 and one on an L4 (issue 687, the comment of 03:25 UTC on November 12). An entry that names a GPU is made only on a machine that has it: the A100 session makes the registered second arm, and the L4 session makes the same sealed tasks as `colab-graph-l4`, into a dataset of its own. `colab-report` (addendum 3, specs/028-dataops-task-set/preregistration-colab-report-arm.md): the failing test's report as a third arm, on the A100 session after its second arm, with its own sealed bundle and its own results. `stop`: every run named here has been made, and the A100 session's three arms have been collected with no task left out (the report arm's kernel ended at 08:11:53 UTC on November 12, 2026). A session that has made its runs and reads this list gives its GPU back; the L4 session does so when its `colab-graph-l4` ends.
